company.name: Elegate
company.shortDescription: Elegate allows brands to create an online store on their website, Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp.
company.description:
We create a branded ordering system for each F&B brand where consumers can order and pay for food and drinks directly from the brand’s own Facebook page. 

Our system supports: 

1- Digital Ordering:  - Users can Order a delivery, track their delivery, or Order a Takeout directly from Facebook messenger. - We create a dashboard where the restaurants can see the placed orders or we can link to the brand's own POS system. 

2- Delivery Tacking: where restaurants & their clients can follow the order & get notification once the order arrived. 

3- Delivery Enablement: we integrate with various 3rd party on-demand delivery service providers so you can get the fastest & most affordable delivery for each order.

Now F&B brands can elegate all their operations, and just focus on making great food.
